candidate_relations.reason: Corticobasal degeneration is a neurodegenerative tauopathy, not an enhancing corpus-callosum mass with coma.
Primary CNS lymphoma is a neoplastic differential for a callosal mass, not cryptococcoma.
There is no known extracranial primary supporting metastatic brain tumor.
Cerebral lymphoma remains a mass-lesion differential, not cryptococcoma.
Lymphomatoid granulomatosis is an EBV-associated lymphoproliferative disease, not cryptococcoma.
ADEM is a multifocal demyelinating illness, not a rim-enhancing callosal mass.
Glioblastoma is a high-grade glioma differential, not cryptococcoma.
Tuberculous abscess is a different infection; T-spot was negative.
CJD does not produce a rim-enhancing callosal mass.
Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation is not an acute mass lesion.
Cerebral vasculitis is not supported by negative ANCA/ANA and this solitary callosal mass.
PML is typically non-enhancing white-matter disease in immunosuppression, not this rim-enhancing mass.
Brain tumor is a radiologic parent of the mass, not cryptococcoma.
Brain metastasis is a different neoplastic category.
Brain abscess is a related ring-enhancing infectious mass family but omits Cryptococcus.
Rasmussen encephalitis is a chronic unihemispheric epilepsy syndrome in children.
Histoplasmosis is a different fungus, not cryptococcoma.
A statement that brain abscess was ruled out is not a diagnosis of cryptococcoma.
Cryptococcoma is the same diagnostic object as the reference for this rim-enhancing corpus-callosum mass.
Neurocysticercosis typically shows cystic scolex lesions, not this callosal cryptococcoma pattern.

case_quality_flags: CSF India ink and fungal cultures were negative in the supplied record; cryptococcoma may rest on later tissue diagnosis not shown.
